key_stat: Pan-European exchange group | Borsa Italiana | MTS fixed income | Euronext Clearing
summary: Euronext is the leading pan-European exchange group operating 7 national exchanges (Amsterdam, Brussels, Dublin, Lisbon, Milan/Borsa Italiana, Oslo, Paris). Also operates Euronext Clearing, MTS (European fixed income), and Euronext Securities (CSDs). Post-Borsa Italiana acquisition, Euronext is building integrated European capital market infrastructure. Technology: Optiq trading platform, clearing system migration, CSD consolidation.

business_segments.name: Trading
business_segments.detail: Cash equities, derivatives, commodities, FX across 7 markets. Optiq platform.

business_segments.name: Clearing
business_segments.detail: Euronext Clearing (formerly CC&G). CCP services. Migrating from LCH.

business_segments.name: Post-Trade & Custody
business_segments.detail: Euronext Securities (CSDs in Denmark, Italy, Norway). Settlement services.

business_segments.name: Data & Technology
business_segments.detail: Market data, indices, technology solutions for clients.

technology.ai: AI for market surveillance, trading analytics.
technology.cloud: Core technology migration. Optiq platform enhancements.
technology.data: Market data feeds. Reference data. Analytics.
technology.platforms: Optiq (trading), Euronext Clearing, CSD platforms, MTS.

operating_model: Pan-European integration. 7 national exchanges consolidating onto Optiq. Euronext Clearing migration from LCH. CSD consolidation.
coforge_angle: NN TAL. Euronext integrating 7 exchanges + clearing + CSDs = massive multi-year technology programme. Coforge can support clearing migration, CSD consolidation, platform engineering, and data.
